messages:
Marta L: Heads up — onboarding report: users confused by 401 vs 403 messages in SDKs. They see 'Unauthorized' but retry flow suggests refresh.
Ryan K: Yep saw that. SDKs return AuthError: 'Unauthorized' and sometimes 403 in other paths. Inconsistent across languages.
Aisha P: Is there a canonical mapping doc? I thought we standardized 401 = refresh token, 403 = permission denied.
Marta L: We do, but some sampleapps swallow the HTTP code and surface a generic message. Example from the node SDK:
```json
{"error": {"type": "AuthError", "http_status": 401, "message": "Unauthorized"}}
```
DevEx Bot: <https://redwood.internal/rfc/error-mapping|RFC: error-mapping> — includes suggested user_hint fields.
Samir: Proposal: make typed exceptions first-class across SDKs with fields: code, http_status, user_hint, retry_after. Keep user_hint short and actionable.
Aisha P: Agree. Also add telemetry tag "handled_by" so we can see if client-side libs auto-retry or bubble up.
Ryan K: Quick win: change UX message for 401 to "Authentication expired. Please call refresh_token() or reauthenticate." For 429 include "Retry after X seconds" when available.
Marta L: Can we align Go/Node/Python SDKs in next patch? Need parity matrix and smoke tests.
Samir: I'll open a PR for Node & Py with unit tests and a sampleapp update. Will put an integration test asserting message contains "refresh" when http_status == 401.
Aisha P: :thumbsup: Add a test for 429 that verifies retry_after is surfaced as a hint.
DevEx Bot: Reminder: update onboarding guide and changelog. @Marta L to own the copy.
Marta L: I'll draft copy today and ping for quick review. Thanks.
